summary_1line: Lomasa recounts how Princess Sukanya accidentally blinded the ascetic Chyavana and was given to him in marriage to appease his anger.

image_candidates.scene_text: Princess Sukanya curiously pierces two glowing points in an anthill with a thorn, unknowingly blinding the meditating sage Chyavana inside.
The aged, anthill-covered sage Chyavana emerges as King Saryati stands with folded hands pleading for forgiveness.
The young princess Sukanya, adorned with jewels, begins serving her frail ascetic husband beside a forest hermitage fire.
